summary: Challenge to High Court orders monitoring implementation of Hema Committee report on Malayalam cinema industry; SIT directed to investigate based on report contents as 'information'; media restrained from trial by publicity; privacy rights emphasized; direction under Sec. 176 BNSS for non-cooperating witnesses; petitioners aggrieved by compulsory investigation steps despite no FIR; locus standi challenged; media conduct regulated to ensure fair investigation.
final_judgment: Permission to file SLP granted in Diary No.55412 of 2024; matter remanded for consideration with directions to respect privacy, fair investigation, and avoid media pressure.
